authored: assignments are a reading of each mutation's own `why`, written by its proposer before the run and without sight of any coverage; they are published per miss so a reader can dispute any one of them

definitions.APERTURE_DOCUMENT: needs a document shape the grammar does not compose
definitions.APERTURE_PAYLOAD: needs an input the generator's fixed literal lists cannot produce
definitions.EQUIVALENT: an equivalent mutant - proved to change no behaviour on any input, so nothing could ever kill it; it stays in the denominator because the spec was frozen without this category, and is named here instead
definitions.OUT_OF_SURFACE: in code the differential never runs, or whose effect never reaches the compared verdict core
definitions.UNREACHABLE: no input could catch it: dead code, or a bound no practical input reaches

caught_by_five_or_fewer.name: absent misses a needle sitting at byte offset zero
signed-zero folding only applies when fractional digits are printed
the working precision in _canon is one digit short
a comment can no longer open exactly where the previous one closed
fractional-digit count taken from the raw token, before normalisation
the tag-candidate lookahead stops excluding _ and -
strict JSON parser stops remembering duplicate keys
strict JSON reads integers as int rather than Decimal

marginality_of_catches.note: disagreements produced by each caught mutation, out of 5000 cases. A catch at the low end is a catch the guard nearly missed.

misses.because: WITHHELD is declared in the vocabulary and emitted by no code path in either implementation — this is a mutation on dead code
misses.name: sworn_total stops counting the WITHHELD verdict

misses.because: provenance requires a repository tree; the JavaScript side has none, so nothing cross-checks it
misses.name: the committed-provenance rung bucket is renamed

misses.because: needs a value sitting exactly on a rounding tie at the printed precision; none of the ten payload literals produces one
misses.name: half-even becomes half-up in the JS BigInt rounder

misses.because: needs a leaf with adjusted exponent -5; the payloads carry 1e5 and 0.4211, nothing that small
misses.name: the scientific-notation threshold in Dec.toString moves by one decade

misses.because: the mirror of the above, on the other side, and blind for the same reason
misses.name: Python quantize rounds half-up instead of half-even

misses.because: differs only at an adjusted exponent of exactly 320
misses.name: the adjusted-exponent magnitude gate moves by one

misses.because: only a span of exactly 300 code points changes verdict; the grammar builds over-cap spans by repeating inner text 20-60 times and lands nowhere near it
misses.name: the span code-point cap becomes exclusive (300 now fails)

misses.because: needs a key containing ~ or /; no payload literal has one
misses.name: JSON Pointer unescaping applies ~0 before ~1 (RFC 6901 order reversed)

misses.because: the receipt-id list carries #L1, #L1-L3 and #L9 — no slice starting at line 2
misses.name: line slice starting past line 1 swallows the previous line's LF

misses.because: every prereg: receipt the grammar emits is already lowercase
misses.name: prereg: digests are no longer case-folded

misses.because: needs a pointer at an array's last index; the receipt-id list has no such pointer
misses.name: array index bound in pointer walking is off by one

misses.because: needs CESU-8 style bytes; the invalid-UTF-8 documents the grammar makes are not of that shape
misses.name: the UTF-8 validator stops rejecting encoded surrogates

misses.because: needs a specific overlong encoding the grammar does not emit
misses.name: the three-byte overlong bound drops from U+0800 to U+0080

misses.because: no payload literal begins with EF BB BF — the miss that started this study
misses.name: the JSON reader stops refusing a BOM

misses.because: needs a surrogate escape in a payload; no literal contains a \u escape at all
misses.name: the lone-surrogate refusal on a pointer leaf is neutered

misses.because: needs an astral character inside a tag opener
misses.name: the opener's end offset is measured in UTF-16 units, not bytes

misses.because: needs a bare CR inside a span's inner text
misses.name: CR stops counting as span whitespace

misses.because: the high word only matters for a message of 2^32 bits, about 512 MB
misses.name: sha256 drops the high word of the 64-bit length field

misses.because: needs a newline inside a JCS-serialised manifest string; the manifest strings are drawn from three constants, none with a newline
misses.name:
JCS emits 
 instead of the short \n escape

misses.because: no payload literal contains either token
misses.name: strict JSON reads NaN/Infinity as float rather than Decimal

misses.because: authored_sha256 is always emitted lowercase by the generator
misses.name: the JS manifest stops case-folding authored_sha256

misses.because: the list is always empty or a single element, so order is unobservable
misses.name: manifest core() emits authored_sha256 unsorted

misses.because: the tree-handle layer is never exercised by the differential
misses.name: SnapshotTree treats a symlink as a blob

misses.because: PROVED equivalent, not merely unobserved. The closer's whole range is cut from the canonical text: the builder does boundaries.set(a, a - removed), then removed += b - a, then boundaries.set(b, b - removed). So boundaries.get(closer_at) and boundaries.get(closer_end) both equal closer_at - removed_before, for every document. No input distinguishes this mutant, so its miss is not a hole in the harness
misses.name: canonical end offset read at the closer's far edge

misses.because: the sidecar layer is not on the path the differential compares
misses.name: render sorts its events, losing closer-before-opener adjacency

misses.because: same layer
misses.name: load_sidecar admits a zero-length span

misses.because: same layer, same reason
misses.name: verify falls back to the tree handle's own commit

misses.because: the receipt layer sits outside the verdict core the digest covers
misses.name: the receipt digest covers coverage again (R9 undone)

misses.because: needs a needle that overlaps itself in the haystack, e.g. aa in aaa
misses.name: occurrences counts overlapping matches
